Swoobat

Psychic Flying

Unova · Generation 5

Swoobat is a Psychic/Flying-type Courting Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 10.5 kg. It evolves from Woobat. Its highest base stat is Speed (114), with a base stat total of 425.
